summary: Senior Project Manager with over 25 years of diverse experience in health care, private sector, local and state government, and aerospace/defense contracting. Proven leadership in project planning, budgeting, design, change control, execution, implementation, and support, with a strong focus on mentoring and training project managers.

experience.title: Director of Information Technology
responsibilities: Member of the Health Care Executive team responsible for technology delivery to two hospitals, 40 clinics, Public Health, Behavioral Health, Medical Examiner, and the County's Health Insurance plan.
Implemented ServiceNow, ITIL, Active Directory, and Office 365 for the agency.
Oversaw outsourcing of the agency's Cerner EHR system, implemented two major Cerner upgrades, and developed the technology plan for the new hospital.
Developed and managed the County's Project Leadership Academy, training and mentoring project managers using PMI/PMP grade materials.

experience.title: Senior Project Manager/Architect/Business Analyst
responsibilities: Managed a $50M Cerner system implementation across two hospitals, 40 clinics, and Public Health in 14 months, including 56 solutions and interfaces to PACS, Pyxis, and external entities.
Provided PMO oversight and mentoring for a $4.5M upgrade of the County's Land Management and Permitting System.
Led enterprise architecture initiatives for a $6M Fire Department IT upgrade, including data warehouse and executive dashboards.
Directed requirements development for a new property tax system serving five county organizations and thousands of taxpayers.
Managed design, development, and implementation of multiple law enforcement and public safety systems (Inmate Management, RMS, Mobile Field Reporting, CAD, Warrants, Case Management).
Oversaw a $4M Cisco-based data network and VoIP implementation, and a $12M countywide microwave project.

experience.title: Principal Consultant/Senior Project Manager
responsibilities: Acted as Project Manager, Architect, and Lead Designer for CRM and web-based workflow projects for clients such as RR Donnelley, Advest, Franciscan Winery, Mattel, and Royal Alliance Associates.
Designed and implemented secure B2B portals, web-based account systems, CRM and decision support solutions, and integrated front office/back office systems.

experience.title: Senior Project Manager
responsibilities: Rearchitected Altris product suite and implemented a Customer Support Desk.

Managed custom engineering drawing change solutions for Arco Alaska, high-volume purchase order capture for Bell Helicopter, contract tracking for MCA/Universal, and distributed database imaging for Caterpillar.
Created and led multiple system delivery organizations, including quality assurance, process re-engineering, and training initiatives.
